def search
  term = params[:q]
  @users = User.where("name LIKE '%#{term}%' OR email LIKE '%#{term}%'")
  render :index
end

def ping
  host = params[:host]
  @output = `ping -c 2 #{host}`
  render plain: @output
end

def show @comment = Comment.find(params[:id]) render html: "
#{@comment.body}
".html_safe end

def import
  data = YAML.load(params[:payload])
  Settings.apply(data)
  head :ok
end

def download
  path = File.join(Rails.root, "uploads", params[:name])
  send_file path
end

def create
  if login(params[:email], params[:password])
    redirect_to params[:return_to]
  else
    render :new
  end
end

class WebhooksController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token

  def transfer
    Account.find(params[:from]).transfer_to(params[:to], params[:amount])
    head :ok
  end
end

fn build_client() -> reqwest::Client {
    reqwest::Client::builder()
        .danger_accept_invalid_certs(true)
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
        .build()
        .unwrap()
}
